newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore noon shares reel, foreign tranches up.
newsitem.headline: Singapore noon shares reel, foreign tranches up.

text.p: Singapore shares reeled on Monday morning from Wall Street's plunge, but foreign tranches of blue chips rose as fears of dual listing mergers faded, dealers said.

"There was a good amount of short-covering of foreign tranches after some of the banks announced on Friday they had no intention to merge their foreign and local tranches," said a dealer with a local bank.
Dominating gainers were foreign tranches of Singapore Press (SPH), DBS, UOB and SIA. SPH rose Singapore $1.30 to S$23.30 with over 1.1 million shares traded.
